stories.place_zh: 新竹縣寶山鄉 · 2 奈米
stories.ctx_zh: 新竹科學園區寶山二期。2022 年 3 月起部分土地租給台積電整地，原本是丘陵、墓地與客家聚落；2 奈米於 2025 年底量產，南側 P3/P4 仍在興建。
stories.ctx_en: Hsinchu Science Park, Baoshan phase 2. TSMC began leveling leased land in spring 2022 on hills that held woods, graves and a Hakka village; 2 nm volume production began in late 2025, and P3/P4 to the south are still being built.

revenue.note_en: Estimate, not reported: TSMC publishes revenue only for the whole company. Each month's TSMC revenue is split by that quarter's process-node mix and by this site's estimated share of each node's capacity (packaging sites: by the advanced-packaging share). Low/high from how certain each split is. Through 2026-08.
revenue.note_zh: 此為估計，非公開數字：台積電只公布全公司營收。每月營收依當季製程組合，再依本廠區在各製程產能中的估計占比拆分（封測廠依先進封裝占比）；範圍依各項拆分的把握程度。資料至 2026-08。

stories.place_zh: 中部科學園區二期 · 1.4 奈米（A14）
stories.place_en: Central Taiwan Science Park phase 2 · 1.4 nm (A14)
stories.ctx_zh: 台積電於 2025 年 6 月取得中科二期擴建用地，2025 年 11 月 5 日開始基礎工程，預計 2028 年下半年量產。
stories.ctx_en: TSMC took over the Central Taiwan Science Park phase 2 expansion land in June 2025 and began foundation work on 5 November 2025; volume production is planned for the second half of 2028.

stories.zh: 台積電全球研發中心（寶山）
stories.place_zh: 新竹科學園區 · 2 奈米以下研發
stories.ctx_zh: 2020 年動工，2023 年 7 月 28 日啟用，總樓地板面積約 30 萬平方公尺，研發人員超過 7,000 人。
stories.ctx_en: Construction started in 2020 and the centre opened on 28 July 2023: about 300,000 m² of floor space for more than 7,000 R&D staff.

stories.place_zh: 南部科學園區 · 5／3 奈米
stories.ctx_zh: 2018 年 1 月 26 日動土，2020 年第二季 5 奈米量產；基地約 42 公頃。
stories.ctx_en: Ground was broken on 26 January 2018 and 5 nm volume production began in Q2 2020; the site is about 42 ha.

stories.zh: 台積電先進封測六廠（竹南）
stories.place_zh: 竹南科學園區 · 3DFabric 先進封裝
stories.ctx_zh: 2020 年動工，2023 年 6 月 8 日啟用，基地 14.3 公頃，是台積電最大的先進封測廠。
stories.ctx_en: Construction began in 2020 and the fab opened on 8 June 2023; at 14.3 ha it is TSMC's largest advanced backend fab.

stories.ctx_en: Fab 12 was built in phases; according to GISA satellite data, most of this part of the site first became impervious surface in 2008–2009.

stories.ctx_en: Fab 15 was built in phases; according to GISA satellite data, part of the site first became impervious in 2011 and a larger part in 2016–2018.

stories.place_zh: 南部科學園區 · 12 吋晶圓廠
stories.ctx_zh: 南科在 1990 年代後期開發；依 GISA 衛星資料，這塊基地大多在 1998–2000 年第一次成為不透水面，後續分期擴建到 2013 年。
stories.ctx_en: The Southern Taiwan Science Park was developed in the late 1990s; according to GISA satellite data, most of this site first became impervious in 1998–2000, with later phases up to 2013.

stories.zh: 台積電先進封測七廠（嘉義）
stories.place_zh: 嘉義科學園區 · 先進封裝
stories.ctx_zh: 2024 年 5 月動工，6 月因發現疑似遺址暫停；2025 年 12 月啟用。基地原為農地，作物也可能被模型讀成部分樹冠。
stories.ctx_en: Construction began in May 2024 and paused in June after a suspected archaeological site was found; it opened in December 2025. The site was farmland, and crops can read as partial tree cover.

stories.place_zh: 楠梓產業園區 · 2 奈米
stories.ctx_zh: 建在中油高雄煉油廠舊址上，2022 年動工、2025 年底 2 奈米量產。煉油廠時期樹冠就很少，所以變化不大。
stories.ctx_en: Built on the former CPC Kaohsiung refinery, with construction from 2022 and 2 nm volume production from late 2025. The refinery left little tree cover, so the change is small.
